🌀 #WilmaPH / #Nokaen Update
Issued: Tuesday, December 2, 2025 
– 7:00 AM Philippine Time

TROPICAL disturbance #93W / #Invest93W in the West Pacific Ocean basin is currently moving northwest at 15 km/h, and is expected to begin a turn toward the southwest on Wednesday, December 3, 2025. As this turn begins, a TROPICAL DEPRESSION is likely to form within the next 24 hours as the system tracks toward the #EasternVisayas and the #Bicol region of #Mindanao, #Philippines.

All residents and friends in these regions should be closely monitoring this system, making immediate preparations, identifying safe shelter, and evacuating coastal areas as necessary. 93W is expected to strengthen into TROPICAL STORM #Wilma / #TropicalStormWilmaPH / #TropicalStormNokaen, bringing the following hazards:

Torrential TROPICAL rain squalls

Winds of 85–110 kph

Dangerous seas, surf, and coastal flooding

Life-threatening flash flooding across both inland & island communities

Serious infrastructure damage, including flooded homes (potentially up to rooftops) and washed-out roads

Please continue to monitor official PAGASA updates and follow the Hurricane/Typhoon/Cyclone Updates & Information page for 24/7 coverage.

Respectfully,

Roshin

data.text:
The truth is no political bloc can; provide a viable endgame that is. 

In Erap's case, the denouement was the impeachment trial. The manufactured evidence and the existence of the Jose Velarde account provided the trigger. Along with the houses Erap was building for each of his mistresses, these convinced the middle class that Erap was guilty. It was the catalyst for Edsa 2 which ousted him and it also helped that the GMA camp had a ready plan supported by both Cory and FVR which led to the final withdrawal of support for the Erap administration. 

In this case, there is none. While the administration is on the defensive, it is by no measure of the administration, on the verge of being overthrown or ousted. 

Since its six year term is now a foregone conclusion, what comes next is continuing political instability. 

The Reds, together with the administration, will go after Inday with impeachment and criminal charges. The vice-president is not immune from suit. 

Should Inday continue to dominate the presidential race in 2028, there is the chance that the administration could see its congressional majority weaken and enable the impeachment of the president. 

While this scenario is a probability, its coming to a fruition is low considering how greedy our legislators are. They can be bribed with campaign funds for the 2028 election. 

Long story short, we're stuck with waiting for the 2028 election. How the administration will fare depends largely on its handling of the flood control scam. It rests on the public being satisfied with whoever big fish is served up on a silver platter. 

The supreme court ruling about fugitives not being entitled to judicial relief will have a major impact because they are not allowed to participate in court proceedings by their counsels. 

Their ability and financial wherewithal to be on the run are keys to their survival. 

But who knows? 

Zaldy Co may still have a bombshell revelation. What happens next depends on what the principal players decide. Whether we care to admit it or not, we the people are just pawns in the games our leaders play. 

So much for democracy. 

"Those who claim leadership over the anti-corruption protest movement must take responsibility for the tepid public response. Neither of the two wings of the protest movement offers a viable strategy and a convincing endgame for the largest corruption scandal in our country’s history."
